About Jonai Girls' College
Jonai Girls' College is situated in the vicinity of Jonai township area established in the year 1994 with the cherished goal of spreading and imparting higher education to backward women section of Jonai Sub-Division, Assam and abutting areas of Arunachal Pradesh. Since the day of its inception, the college has been relentlessly working to attain its cherished goal of spreading the light of knowledge to hitherto uncontested weaker section of this area.
